{{Region Infobox |image = Night City.png |map = Solaris-3 |chapter = |main city = |festival = |controlling_entity = |demonym = }} {{Description|Born of a fevered hallucination, this bustling concrete jungle is shrouded in eternal night, revealing a completely different cityscape.
A cage forged from sorrow and despair. A graveyard of unfinished dreams and a time long gone.|Loading Screen}} '''Somnoire: Night City''' is a location in the [[Somnoire]], borne out of the dreams and nightmares of former Night City inhabitant, [[Lucy]]. As a simulacrum, it brings together the dreams both of Night City denizens and Startorch Academy students and faculty from Lahai-Roi. The city in reality was founded in 1993 in the United States of America, on the shores of Del Coronado Bay at the border between Northern and Southern California. As a part of the collaboration with {{w|Cyberpunk: Edgerunners}}, it is broadly modelled after locations in the anime, and the video game {{w|Cyberpunk 2077}}. ==Areas== {| class="article-table alternating-colors-table tdc1" style="width: 100%;" ! style="width: 200px;" |Name !
